report.answer_text:
Jim proposes to Pam in the Season 5 premiere, "Weight Loss" (Season 5, Episodes 1/2).
Jim meets Pam for lunch at an interstate rest stop between Scranton and New York City. He proposes to her outside in the pouring rain, and she accepts ecstatically.[1] Pam was in New York for a graphic design class at the time.
Jim had planned to propose earlier. In "Chair Model," he shows off the ring he plans to use.[2] His attempt in the Season 4 finale, "Goodbye, Toby," didn't happen, and Pam is disappointed that he didn't propose.[3]
The scene was expensive to film. Jenna Fischer said it was the most expensive scene of the whole series. It lasts 52 seconds and cost $250,000.[4]
